title: QuickZoom
description: A simple, configurable zoom mod for NeoForge.
body:
**QuickZoom** — A simple, configurable zoom mod.

Hold **C** (configurable) to zoom in **2x–16x**, with optional **cinematic camera** and **smooth FOV transition**.

**Features:**

**Adjustable 2x–16x zoom**.

**Optional cinematic camera (F8 smooth camera effect)**.

**Optional smooth zoom transition (telescope-style)**.

**All settings configurable in-game via Mods → QuickZoom → Config**.
